topics.description: Life is short — enjoy the moment!

categories.title: SEO
categories.description: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is a set of techniques and strategies for improving a website's organic ranking in search engines. The goal is to make a site easier for search engines to understand and index, which increases visibility and traffic. Whether it is content optimisation, technical restructuring or a better user experience, SEO is an essential part of any modern website. For front-end developers, understanding SEO not only improves site performance but also brings real results to the product.

categories.title: JavaScript
categories.description:
JavaScript is a high-level interpreted programming language that runs in browsers and on servers.
It was originally designed to make web pages interactive, and has since become the standard language of front-end development, widely used for back-end work (such as Node.js), mobile apps, desktop apps and even IoT development.
This category covers my development notes on JS.

categories.title: Bundlers
categories.description: A bundler is an indispensable front-end tool that combines many modules (JavaScript, CSS, images, fonts and other assets) into one or a few files a browser can run. Common bundlers include Webpack, Vite and Parcel. Bundling improves site performance and reduces load time, while supporting modular development and asset optimisation (minification, splitting, caching and more).
